about.title: About REAKTON
about.metaDescription: REAKTON — electronic duo from Berlin. Robotronic music between Kraftwerk tradition and electronic pop culture.
about.intro: REAKTON is an electronic duo from Berlin. Robert Waters and Adriano Theel create Robotronic music — precise synth-pop productions spanning cosmic album worlds, nano-futurism, and club night.
about.quote: How would it sound if Kraftwerk continued to write music?
about.quoteAttribution: The question Adriano Theel asked in 2013 — quoted in the Side-Line interview, 2020
about.body: The answer is not nostalgic pastiche but an evolution of what still resonates in the Kraftwerk lineage: clear rhythms, machine aesthetics, and themes from the present. Albums such as Universe:Earth:Human and Micro:Macro:Nano connect that tradition with lyrics and sounds about data, medicine, smart dust, and digital everyday life.
about.body2: REAKTON has performed live at Tempodrom Berlin, among other venues. Press, previews, and contact are available from the navigation — the three worlds on the home page remain the core experience of this site.
